name: Mozzy
notes: Sacramento's mobb-lineage street rap, and the parameter that carries it is *slowness with nothing on top*. This is the only entry on this axis that sits **below** the lane's 95–107 spine: 80–92 straight 2&4, mode 86. Everything else follows from the research's one causal sentence — "note density in the beat is deliberately low because the vocal density is very high" — so `melody.densityPerBar` is 1–4, `loopVerbatim` is on for the two-bar cell the research says is "repeated without variation", and `percs.lanes` is emptied: "almost no percussion layering — the sparseness is the Bay/Sacramento inheritance". ⚠ **The 808 register is widened past what the research states, on purpose.** It says D1–A1, which is seven semitones, and a P4 or P5 slide inside seven semitones has nowhere to land — `bass808.rs` requires a slide target inside the register. `[26, 40]` keeps the researched D1 floor and buys the slide somewhere to go; the low end is the researched parameter and the ceiling is engine headroom. ⚠ The **808 stays the bass** (`role` inherited as `bassline`), because the research describes a long slow-decaying 808 moving between two chord roots — not a played instrument — so no separate `bassline` part is authored. ⚠ `maxChords` is 2 and the families are only `i–VI` and `i–VII`, which is exactly what the research names; the `i` family is INFERRED from "repeated without variation" and carries the lowest weight. ⚠ `confidence` is `medium` because the research rates this medium-high, and **`chords.extensions` is the inferred parameter** — "minor-with-flat-6" is a colour, not a measured seventh/ninth split. The secondary 130–160 half-time population the research measures is **not** modelled as a mode; this entry is the 80–92 record, and the half-time cuts are the lane's own half-time behaviour. Fill fingerprint band G: `fills` 4/4, a 32nd `strong_weak_weak_weak` roll at the highest gap probability in this batch (the "32nd rolls only at bar-ends" the research names), hat rolls 0.62 per bar at `phrase_end` only. ⚠ **`lockTo808` raised from 0.5 to 0.61.** The 808 takes each kick with this probability, and at 0.5 over this model's 8-kick floor a seed could produce no 808 at all — which `bass808.rs` refuses, because a declared 808 that sometimes vanishes is a part a producer cannot rely on. It is still well under a lock: a good share of kicks carry no sub.
